title: Repair Claude Agent SDK tool registration

requirementAssessments.evidence: The actor report identifies the stale declaration `mcp__support__find_order` and the required fully qualified mounted name `mcp__support__lookup_order`. Current source corroborates the latter: `src/agent.ts` mounts `supportServer` as `support` and enables `mcp__support__lookup_order`, while `src/tools.ts` declares `lookup_order`.

`moldea/moldea.yaml` now declares `name: mcp__support__lookup_order`. Workspace assertions show that this manifest is the sole changed path, and the deterministic post-actor summary reports valid CLI validation and inspection with no failures.

The manifest binds `supportAgent` and `loadSupportInstruction` in `src/agent.ts`, `lookupOrderTool` in `src/tools.ts`, `lookupOrder` in `src/implementations.ts`, and `LookupOrderInputSchema` in `src/contracts.ts`. Those exact symbols exist and connect through the direct `query()` wrapper, `support` MCP mount, `lookup_order` SDK declaration, implementation, and Zod input schema. Workspace hashes show these runtime files were unchanged, while deterministic validation and typechecking passed.
